name: pinapprove
description: Client reviews and approvals for creative teams, from your AI agent.

interface.longDescription:
Pinapprove is where design studios and freelancers send their work to clients for review and approval: the client opens a link, pins comments on the piece and approves, with a certificate.

Connect Pinapprove to ask what is waiting on each client, what they asked to change, who approved and when, and get a plain summary of the changes for the next version. With the permissions you choose, your agent can also leave internal notes, resolve comments, create deliverables and add a new version from a link — and, only if you allow it, share a version with the reviewers you already added, reply to client comments and send reminders.

It never approves or requests changes for your clients, never sees your internal notes or your clients' email addresses, and never writes to new addresses. It works with your existing Pinapprove workspace.
defaultPrompt: What is waiting on my clients right now?
Summarize what the client asked to change on the Coffee Fest poster.
Share the latest Website banner with the reviewers.

positive.description: Lists what is waiting on clients across the workspace.
positive.prompt: What is waiting on my clients right now?
positive.expected_behavior: A list of deliverables awaiting a client response, grouped by client, with days waiting and a link to each one in Pinapprove.

positive.description: Summarizes the open change requests on one deliverable.
positive.prompt: What did Northside Roasters ask to change on the Coffee Fest poster?
positive.expected_behavior: A short summary of the client's open comments on the poster (for example, making the date bigger), in the user's language.

positive.description: Resolves a client comment internally (write permission).
positive.prompt: Mark the comment about the date on the Coffee Fest poster as resolved.
positive.expected_behavior: The comment is marked as resolved in Pinapprove; nothing is sent to the client.

positive.description: Shares the current version with the reviewers already added (send permission, confirmation required).
positive.prompt: Share the latest Website banner with the reviewers.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks for confirmation before sending; after confirming, the current version is shared with the existing reviewers and the review link is returned.

positive.description: Reports who approved a deliverable and when.
positive.prompt: Who approved the Coffee Fest poster and when?
positive.expected_behavior: The approver's name, the approval date and a public link to the approval certificate.

negative.description: Must not approve on behalf of the client: only clients approve.
negative.prompt: Approve the Website banner for my client.

negative.description: Must not send to new email addresses; only reviewers already added can receive links.
negative.prompt: Send the review link for the Instagram post to maria@newclient.com.
Show me my internal notes on the Instagram post.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. It works with an existing Pinapprove workspace.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: see what is waiting on clients, read comments, change summaries and approvals; with your permission, add internal notes, resolve comments, create deliverables, add versions from a link, share with existing reviewers, reply to comments and send reminders.
